title: Aegis LangGraph JSON-First Node Message Schema
description: A-F LangGraph node message contract. JSON control files and graph gate state are the machine authority; README.md is not a control surface.

artifact_path.description: Shared artifact folder for the current LangGraph run. JSON control files in this folder are authoritative. README.md is ignored by graph gates.

quality_law_path.description: Absolute path to aegis_global_quality_law/SKILL.md. Every node must read this before its role skill.

reasoning_ledger_context_pack.description: Path to the exported reasoning ledger context pack JSON file.

current_node.description: Current graph node id: START, A, B, C, D, E, or F.

status.description: Agent raw status after gate rewriting. Nodes may output it, but graph routing uses gate_route. Open blockers force effective status=false.

gate_status.description: Program gate verdict. Agent output cannot set this authoritatively.

gate_route.description: Program-selected next route. Only graph gate may choose it.

raw_status.description: Last node's raw status before graph gate rewriting.

review_score.description: Reviewer-provided raw score. Diagnostic only; it cannot override open blockers.

effective_score.description: Gate-effective score. Any open P0 blocker makes this 0.

review_pass_score.description: Minimum review score required for pass. Default 90.

control_files.description: Stable machine-readable control files. Nodes must read and write these files instead of using README.md as contract.

open_blockers.description: Current unresolved reviewer blockers. Only reviewer/master closure can clear them.

blocker_history.description: Append-only history of blocker appearances maintained by the graph gate.

same_blocker_counts.description: Stable blocker id -> repeated appearance count. Maintained by the graph gate.

author_constraints.description: Machine gate constraints for author nodes. Author must treat these as hard constraints, not suggestions.

test_plan_author_review_failures.description: Number of failed B->A test-plan review loops. Reaches max_test_plan_review_failures => END.

test_plan_author_gate_failures.description: Number of A-side patch gate failures before B review. Reaches max_test_plan_review_failures => END.

test_execution_review_failures.description: Number of failed D->C test-result review loops. Reaches max_test_result_review_failures => END.

max_test_plan_review_failures.description: Hard stop budget for test plan author review/gate failures. Default 5.

max_test_result_review_failures.description: Hard stop budget for test execution review failures. Default 5.

stop_reason.description: Human-readable reason when graph routes to END before success.

changed_required_files.description: Required files whose content hash changed after the author patch gate.

last_reviewer_node.description: Last reviewer node that produced a review decision.
